subject: Onboarding request: Sable-7B variant + deployment safeguards
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aimee Carter <aimee@acme-ai.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T09:12:00Z
Subject: Onboarding request: Sable-7B variant + deployment safeguards

Team —

We're kicking off onboarding for a partner-supplied model (Sable-7B, "instruct-lite" variant) that IgniteCorp wants available on Hosted and Dedicated. They flagged higher-than-expected sampling variance on long-context QA prompts in their internal evals; product asks we bring this in under a guarded rollout so customer UX isn't impacted.

What I need from infra/serving/research:
- Compatibility check: tokenizer alignment, KV cache behaviour (shapes/size), any fused-kernel requirements.
- Quantization readiness: vendor provides 8-bit PTQ but we should validate perf vs FP16 on our runtime.
- Canary plan: suggested window 2027-05-02 -> 2027-05-09, with staggered traffic (5% -> 25% -> 100%) and automatic rollback on metrics.
- Metrics to gate on: p95 latency, error_rate (5xxs), prompt-quality drift measured by dev-eval prompt set (I attached the eval set identifiers).
- Pinning ask: if compatibility passes, product wants to pin the variant for 3 weeks post-rollout to avoid accidental variant swaps while we monitor.

Attachments: sable-onboarding-checklist.pdf (checklist + required artifacts), sable-inference-benchmarks.csv (partner baseline).

Aimee — can you confirm the exact tokenizer and whether the weights include a KV-friendly layout or require remapping?

Thanks,
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Product Manager, Model Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Sable-7B variant + deployment safeguards

Naomi —

Thanks for the summary. Quick follow-ups (so infra can scope compute + kernel work):
- Can you paste the partner baseline for p50/p95 latency and peak memory (resident) for a 2048 and 4096 token context? I looked in the CSV but want you to call out the numbers we should match.
- Does the variant require a custom attention kernel (e.g., grouped-attention) or any non-standard ops? If so we need to plan a kernel backfill and it will affect rollout.
- I'll run a quick memory profile on staging once we have the weights. ETA for that is 3 business days after we get the manifest + sample weights.

If the partner baseline shows >20% degradation vs our existing 7B references on p95 at 2048, recommend we hold on full traffic until we can quantize+retest.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Infrastructure Lead, Serving Runtime

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-18T11:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Sable-7B variant + deployment safeguards

Looping in routing considerations. A couple of operational asks: 
- Canary routing: I agree with the 5/25/100 cadence but we should add an intermediate 50% step if latency is borderline — reduces risk of large p95 jumps.
- Fallback variant: propose we register a pre-approved fallback label "sable-7b-quantized-v1" that the smart router can switch to automatically if latency or error_rate thresholds breach. We need a pin policy that prevents auto-rotation during the monitoring window (3 weeks).
- KV cache: do we need to persist/rehydrate across warm restarts? If the partner uses variable-length KV shapes that differ from our standard pad, we'll need a small adapter in the runtime.

If Marcus confirms no custom kernels, I can wire the canary in two working days once weights are available.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Product Manager, Serving Orchestration

From: Aimee Carter <aimee@acme-ai.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-19T07:42:00Z
Subject: Re: Onboarding request: Sable-7B variant + deployment safeguards

Thanks Naomi — quick clarifications from IgniteCorp / Acme AI (we're the model maintainers):
- Tokenizer: SentencePiece v0.1 (unigram) with unk/cls tokens as documented in manifest. No bespoke tokenization hooks.
- Weights: full FP16 weights + an 8-bit PTQ pack. The weights include a standard KV layout; no fused/custom attention kernels required. We've validated against a 2k and 4k context locally. Baseline numbers (local, single A100): p50 22ms @2k, p95 110ms @2k; p95 @4k 240ms; resident memory peaks shown in attached CSV.
- Manifest/samples: s3://acme-weights/sable-7b/v1/manifest.json (I added to related_links). You should have read access; if not, tell me the account and I will grant.
- Fallback: we can produce an additional quantized-only artifact if you want a separate fallback tag.

Happy to join a quick sync if you want to walk through the checklist. We can also provide an extended 48-hour uplift for any urgent kernel validation.

—Aimee Carter
Partner Success, Acme AI

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aimee Carter <aimee@acme-ai.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-20T15:03:00Z
Subject: RE: Onboarding request: Sable-7B variant + deployment safeguards

Thanks everyone — good progress. Action summary here so we can close the loop and request the pin: 
1) Marcus: run compatibility + memory profile on the manifest/weights (ETA 2027-04-22). If p95 at 2k exceeds our reference by >20% we pause and quantify.
2) Karthik: prepare canary wiring with fallback label "sable-7b-quantized-v1" and added 50% intermediate step; target staging canary 2027-04-28.
3) Priya: open the telemetry eval job (dev-eval prompt set) and surface drift thresholds; we will gate on perplexity drift >3% or any top-3 prompt quality regressions.
4) Aimee: please grant read to the S3 manifest to infra if not already done and share the quantized artifact for fallback.

Pin request: product requests a controlled pin for the "instruct-lite" variant for 3 weeks post full rollout. This is to prevent accidental variant replacements while we collect longitudinal metrics. Can leadership (Evelyn) sign off on the 3-week pin and the automatic fallback policy?

If I don't hear objections by EOD 2027-04-21 I'll file the pin request in the governance tracker and mark the thread pending sign-off.

Thanks — Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Product Manager, Model Platform
Redwood Inference
